en: The image shows the reverse side of a written postcard lying on top of a notebook and other cards. The postcard has blue handwritten text in Finnish, an oval postal or ship stamp in blue ink, and a Finnish postage stamp depicting seals and labeled 'SUOMI • FINLAND'. The top has the printed logo 'SILJA LINE', a well‑known ferry company in the Baltic Sea. The notebook page underneath also contains handwritten Finnish text.
